name: stop-list
description: Стоп-лист смены — тестовое задание (React + Express + TypeScript)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server --include=dev && npm install --prefix client --include=dev
